slides.heading: Welcome to Anew Avenue Biomagnetism
slides.body: Welcome to a revolutionary approach to energy medicine. This training is structured around a simple, powerful framework that answers the core questions of healing: Why, What, When, Where, How, and Now. As you progress through these modules, you are not just learning traditional biomagnetism—you are mastering a brand-new paradigm that integrates advanced Chakra Mapping directly into practical therapeutic scans.

slides.heading: Following is the roadmap of your journey:
THE WHY (The Mission):
slides.body: Why are you here? Because true wellness requires looking beyond surface biochemistry. The human body is an energetic system driven by electromagnetic resonance and pH balance. We look directly at the root causes of distortion to restore true equilibrium.

slides.heading: THE WHAT (The Science):
slides.body: What is bio-resonance? It is the study of how living cells communicate via frequencies. You will learn the science of how applying precise magnetic pairs can stabilize an internal environment and correct bio-electric imbalances.

slides.heading: THE WHEN (The History):
slides.body: When did this begin? This isn't a temporary trend. Your training follows a thousands-year-old timeline—from ancient civilizations utilizing natural lodestones, through the 19th-century era of medical electrodynamics, to modern quantum biology.

slides.heading: THE WHERE (The Energetic Anatomy):
slides.body: Where does the healing focus? This is the core of our practice. You will explore physical and energetic anatomy, learning our unique, advanced mapping of major, minor, and micro chakras—and discovering how physical coordinate pairs connect directly to these energy centers to create true bio-resonance.

slides.heading: THE HOW (The Application):
slides.body: How do we apply this knowledge? This is the mechanics of your practice. You will master the practical polarity of magnets, utilizing a distinct dual-color red and black indicator system to accurately display and balance therapeutic pairs on the body.

slides.heading: THE NOW (The Action & The App):
slides.body: How do you bring this to life right now? This is where everything changes. "The Now" is your progressive web app. You will learn to navigate the app's digital interface, activate the specialized Chakra Scan module, track user progress in real-time, and confidently apply these precise protocols at a moment's notice.

slides.heading: How to Navigate This Course:
slides.body:
- Course Access: You have full, unlimited access to this training portal and all course materials for 1 full year from your enrollment date.
- App Integration: To support your practical training, your enrollment includes 1 year of free access to the Anew Avenue Biomagnetism Progressive Web App and the specialized Chakra Scan module.
- Professional Certification: Upon successfully finishing all modules, you will receive an official Certificate of Completion celebrating your mastery of this advanced energetic anatomy and digital scanning protocol.
- Modules must be completed in order.
- Take your time with the material on each page.
- Once you have reviewed the content, click the Complete & Next button below to unlock the next section.

Let's begin.
